rule: Raw input is allowed only where mode is ONLY_ON_DEVICE or NONE. See DATA_TYPES.md.

explain.personal.note: Explains the person's own result from the on-screen verdict, exact values and private answers. Without a device model the app offers the general explanation instead

program.currentStatus.note: Always queried for every program in the pack

nearby.help.note: Location is the county centroid, never device GPS

onDeviceFailure.note: Never applies to ONLY_ON_DEVICE tasks. A PREFER_ON_DEVICE task has cloud-safe input by the rule above, so the retry sends nothing that the first attempt could not have sent.

offlineSample.when: no network and no on-device model
offlineSample.note: The fields of a bundled sample are filled from its fixed answer key on the device. No model is used, nothing is sent, and the result is labelled as sample answers.

recordedSample.appliesTo: the bundled English sample paystub, with nothing hidden
recordedSample.when: no on-device model here (web or iOS), and the person chooses it or presses the one-press judges' path
recordedSample.note: The on-device model's own answer to this silhouette, from a bundled on-device run recording (shared/schemas/device-check-run), is used as the reading: the values are put back on this device now, nothing is sent, and the result is labelled as a recording with the machine and the date.

recordedCloud.appliesTo: the bundled English sample paystub, with nothing hidden
recordedCloud.note: A real cloud reading of this silhouette, recorded with the exact request body and the response (web/eval/results/cloud-recording/, made by web/eval/record-cloud.mjs): the response's placeholder ids are used as the reading, the values are put back on this device now, nothing is sent, and the record shows the exact request sent when it was recorded, labelled as a recording with its date.

onDeviceLocales.note: A task with a locale condition prefers the device only when the answer language is in route_ondevice_locales_{platform}. Where the SDK does not let the app ask the device model which languages it supports (iOS), this Remote Config list is the only check.
